title: 黃旗搖搖過馬路
subject: a retired volunteer crossing guard at a Tainan primary-school corner waving his big yellow flag at 7:20 each morning, and the day he is five minutes late and the children stop the traffic with his flag themselves
caption: Mandarin 1970s glam rock stomp, singalong boogie with a Taiwanese school-corner setting. Crunchy overdriven electric guitar playing a chunky boogie riff in open A chords, stomping live drums with a heavy kick-and-snare backbeat, round driving bass guitar, tambourine and group handclaps on the chorus. 1970s glam-rock studio recording, big roomy drums, dry crunchy guitar, warm tape saturation. Male lead, bright warm tenor, cheerful and clearly sung with a strong melody, gang of friends and children chanting the chorus in unison. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 120 BPM, A major. bright, bustling, affectionate mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no electronic drums, no synth bass, no ballad slowdown.
lyrics:
[Intro - boogie guitar riff, stomping drums, handclaps]

[Verse 1]
七點二十分 路口黃旗揮
我是老陳 退休三年了
小學生一隊 過馬路排排走
我的旗子 比老師還大

[Pre-Chorus]
左邊來車 停一停
右邊機車 慢一慢

[Chorus]
來來來 過馬路 一二三
黃旗搖搖 跟我走
紅燈變綠 我不趕你們
小腳小腳 踩斑馬

[Verse 2]
有個小女孩 每天數我揮幾下
她說昨天十二下 今天十五下
我說老人家 手臂在跳舞

[Pre-Chorus]
今早我感冒 遲到了五分鐘
路口那邊 怎麼這麼靜

[Chorus]
來來來 過馬路 一二三
黃旗搖搖 自己走
小女孩舉著我的旗
公車停下來 乖乖等

[Bridge - guitar and bass only, drums drop out]
我站在遠遠的巷口
手裡拿著藥 眼睛濕濕

[Chorus]
來來來 過馬路 一二三
黃旗搖搖 一起走
老陳也排進隊伍
小腳小腳 帶我過

[Outro - boogie riff, stomps and handclaps fade]
明天七點二十 我準時
